result.title: Giant Spicy Ramyeon Mukbang

evidences.text: Large mound of sauced spicy noodles being eaten on a platter
Four boiled egg halves garnished across the front of the noodles
Piece of spicy cabbage kimchi picked up and eaten
Cooked mini sausages with slit ends arranged along the rim of the platter
Sliced green onions placed next to the boiled eggs
